time_zone.title: Time zone
time_zone.description: IANA zone of deal windows (weekday/time, overnight) unless a deal sets its own — use the website's zone.

rounding.title: Rounding of computed discounts
rounding.description: Percent and pro-rata discounts are rounded once per deal and line.

rate_per_minute.title: Quotes per minute (per website)
rate_per_minute.description: Rate limit of quote, offer and lock requests; 429 with Retry-After above it.

quote_ttl_minutes.title: Quote lifetime (minutes)
quote_ttl_minutes.description: How long a quote can be committed to an order.

anonymous_limited_deals.title: Per-customer-limited deals for guests
anonymous_limited_deals.description: Deals with a per-customer limit need an identified customer, or apply to guests too.

trust_browser_customer.title: Trust customer fields from browsers
trust_browser_customer.description: Browser (pk_) quotes may send customer segments and order counts. Off: only server (sk_) quotes and the verified SS-Identity customer count.

release_on_cancel.title: Release usage when an order is cancelled
release_on_cancel.description: order.cancelled@1 gives the deal's uses and stock back.

catalog_lookup.title: Fill line details from the synced catalog
catalog_lookup.description: Collections, brand, attributes and prices the cart did not send come from items synced by API or events.

max_condition_length.title: Maximum condition length
max_condition_length.description: Length of a rules@1 condition (scope.when, conditions.when).

deal_cache_seconds.title: Deal cache (seconds)
deal_cache_seconds.description: How long an instance reuses a website's deals between quotes (writes on the same instance refresh it at once).
